reviewItem.question: For "Add `CAInjectorMerging` feature gate to the ca-injector, enabling this will change the behavior of the ca-injector to merge in new CA certificates instead of…", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

proposed.statement: A new CAInjectorMerging feature gate is added to the ca-injector; when enabled, the injector merges new CA certificates instead of replacing the existing one.
